dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Ayo, you look like a cat with nine lives. I got somethin' for ya.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's that?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I know where the Johnson brothers are hidin'. They've been movin' product left and right.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: And what do you want in return, Malik?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Just make sure they don't come after me when it's all said and done. Deal?

quest: Victor has information about an upcoming high-stakes heist but won't reveal it until the protagonist retrieves a stolen artifact from a rival gang.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Hey there, listen up. I've got info you need, but it ain't free. Some punk crew swiped something of mine.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's that got to do with me?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I want it back. You fetch that and I'll talk. Understand, pal?

quest: Juan has information about a recent heist involving a valuable artifact but needs protection from the crime boss in exchange for his knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Hola, amigo. I've heard you're the one to talk to when things need... solving.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What do you have in mind, Juan?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: There's this thing, see? An artifact. Stolen recently. I know who took it, but the boss is... watching me.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's your cut, Juan?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I just want to be safe, comprende? You keep the boss off my back, I'll give you what you need.

quest: Derrick has information on a high-profile crime lord's operation, but he won't talk to the cops. He needs the protagonist's help to set up a meet and get paid.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Hey there, I hear you're the one making waves in this city.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: I try my best. What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Derrick Johnson. Listen, I've got info that could bring down a big fish, but the cops ain't gonna do nothin' with it.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's in it for you?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I need you to set up a meet. I want protection and a cut of the action. You make that happen, and I'll sing like a canary.

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: Ah, you're new here. I hear things, see things. For the right price, maybe I can help you too.

dialogue.speaker: Protagonist
dialogue.text: What's your price?

dialogue.speaker: NPC
dialogue.text: I want immunity from that last job. I know who set it up, but I need protection first.
